text: Order came 50 mins late, the app kept saying 'arriving in 5 mins' for half an hour.
english: Order came 50 mins late, the app kept saying 'arriving in 5 mins' for half an hour.

text: ऑर्डर डेढ़ घंटे बाद पहुँचा, ऐप पर बार-बार टाइम बढ़ता रहा।
english: The order arrived after an hour and a half, and the time on the app kept going up.

text: Bhai delivery itni late kyu? 1 ghanta ho gaya, app pe abhi bhi 'on the way' dikha raha hai
english: Brother, why is the delivery so late? It's been an hour and the app still shows 'on the way'.

text: Biryani was hot and the portion was huge, easily fed two of us. Will order again!
english: Biryani was hot and the portion was huge, easily fed two of us. Will order again!

text: दाल मखनी बहुत स्वादिष्ट थी, बिल्कुल घर जैसा खाना।
english: The dal makhani was very tasty, just like home food.

text: Paneer butter masala ekdum mast tha, quantity bhi achhi thi
english: The paneer butter masala was excellent, and the quantity was good too.

text: Refund for the missing paneer tikka still not credited, it's been 6 days. Support keeps saying 24-48 hours.
english: Refund for the missing paneer tikka still not credited, it's been 6 days. Support keeps saying 24-48 hours.

text: मेरे पैसे कट गए लेकिन ऑर्डर कन्फर्म नहीं हुआ। अब तक रिफंड नहीं मिला।
english: My money was deducted but the order was not confirmed. I still haven't got a refund.

text: Refund abhi tak nahi aaya, 5 din ho gaye. Customer care wale bas wait karo bolte hain
english: The refund still hasn't come, it's been 5 days. Customer care just keeps saying wait.

text: App crashes every time I try to apply a coupon at checkout. Android 14, latest version.
english: App crashes every time I try to apply a coupon at checkout. Android 14, latest version.

text: ऐप बहुत धीमा चलता है, मेन्यू खुलने में ही आधा मिनट लग जाता है।
english: The app is very slow, the menu alone takes half a minute to open.

text: App baar baar logout ho jaata hai, har baar OTP daalna padta hai. Bahut irritating hai
english: The app keeps logging me out, I have to enter the OTP every time. Very irritating.

text: Delivery guy was super polite and even waited while I came down from the 4th floor. Tipped him :)
english: Delivery guy was super polite and even waited while I came down from the 4th floor. Tipped him :)

text: डिलीवरी वाले भैया ने बारिश में भी समय पर खाना पहुँचाया, बहुत धन्यवाद।
english: The delivery person brought the food on time even in the rain, thank you very much.

text: Rider bhaiya bahut helpful the, building dhoondhne mein khud call karke help ki
english: The rider was very helpful, he called me himself to help find the building.

text: Food was okay, nothing special. Delivery was on time though.
english: Food was okay, nothing special. Delivery was on time though.

text: खाने का स्वाद ठीक-ठाक था, कुछ खास नहीं।
english: The food tasted okay, nothing special.

text: Khana average tha, na accha na bura. Packing theek thi
english: The food was average, neither good nor bad. The packing was fine.

text: Got charged twice for one order via UPI. Money debited both times, only one order placed.
english: Got charged twice for one order via UPI. Money debited both times, only one order placed.

text: एक ही ऑर्डर के लिए दो बार पैसे कटे हैं, कृपया जल्दी वापस करें।
english: Money was deducted twice for the same order, please return it quickly.

text: Payment fail hua lekin paise kat gaye, ab kya karu?
english: The payment failed but the money was deducted, what do I do now?

text: New UI is cleaner, finding past orders is much easier now.
english: New UI is cleaner, finding past orders is much easier now.

text: नया अपडेट अच्छा है, अब ऑर्डर ट्रैक करना आसान हो गया है।
english: The new update is good, tracking orders is easier now.

text: Naya dark mode accha laga, raat ko aankhon ko aaram milta hai
english: I liked the new dark mode, it is easy on the eyes at night.

text: Arrived 10 mins before the estimated time, impressed.
english: Arrived 10 mins before the estimated time, impressed.

text: खाना समय से पहले आ गया, गरम भी था।
english: The food came before time, and it was hot too.

text: Order time se pehle aa gaya, full marks
english: The order came before time, full marks.

text: The pizza was cold and soggy, cheese had gone rubbery. Not worth 450 rupees.
english: The pizza was cold and soggy, cheese had gone rubbery. Not worth 450 rupees.

text: रोटियाँ कच्ची थीं और सब्ज़ी में बहुत ज़्यादा तेल था।
english: The rotis were undercooked and the curry had far too much oil.

text: Biryani mein chawal kachcha tha aur chicken bilkul fresh nahi laga
english: The rice in the biryani was undercooked and the chicken did not taste fresh at all.

text: Rider asked me to cancel the order and pay him cash instead. Felt very sketchy.
english: Rider asked me to cancel the order and pay him cash instead. Felt very sketchy.

text: डिलीवरी बॉय ने बहुत बदतमीज़ी से बात की और खाना गेट पर रखकर चला गया।
english: The delivery boy spoke very rudely and left the food at the gate and went away.

text: Delivery boy ne extra 20 rupaye maange change ke naam pe, not done yaar
english: The delivery boy asked for 20 rupees extra in the name of change, not done.

text: Refund came back to my wallet within an hour, quick resolution. Thanks.
english: Refund came back to my wallet within an hour, quick resolution. Thanks.

text: रिफंड दो घंटे में खाते में आ गया, अच्छी सेवा।
english: The refund reached my account in two hours, good service.

text: Is there a way to schedule an order for tomorrow morning? Couldn't find it in the app.
english: Is there a way to schedule an order for tomorrow morning? Couldn't find it in the app.

text: कूपन लगाने पर हर बार एरर आता है, पेमेंट पेज पर ऐप अटक जाता है।
english: Every time I apply a coupon I get an error, and the app gets stuck on the payment page.

text: पैकिंग अच्छी थी लेकिन ऑर्डर 40 मिनट लेट था।
english: The packing was good but the order was 40 minutes late.

text: உணவு மிகவும் சுவையாக இருந்தது, மீண்டும் ஆர்டர் செய்வேன்.
english: The food was very tasty, I will order again.

text: டெலிவரி ஒரு மணி நேரம் தாமதமாக வந்தது.
english: The delivery came an hour late.

text: খাবার ঠান্ডা ছিল আর স্বাদও ভালো ছিল না।
english: The food was cold and the taste was not good either.

text: রিফান্ড এখনও পাইনি, তিন দিন হয়ে গেল।
english: I still haven't received the refund, it has been three days.
